verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת לְדָוִ֥ד מִכְתָּֽם׃ הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’al- taš·ḥêṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ miḵ·tām ha·’um·nām ’ê·lem ṣe·ḏeq tə·ḏab·bê·rūn mê·šā·rîm tiš·pə·ṭū bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of Do Not Destroy A Miktam of David Do you indeed speak justly O rulers Do you judge uprightly O sons of men

verses.original: אַף־ בְּלֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן בָּאָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- bə·lêḇ ‘ō·w·lōṯ tip̄·‘ā·lūn bā·’ā·reṣ ḥă·mas yə·ḏê·ḵem tə·p̄al·lê·sūn
verses.literal: No in your hearts you devise injustice with your hands you mete out violence on the earth

verses.original: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵרָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: zō·rū rə·šā·‘îm mê·rā·ḥem tā·‘ū mib·be·ṭen dō·ḇə·rê ḵā·zāḇ
verses.literal: The wicked are estranged from the womb the liars . . . go astray from birth

verses.original: חֲמַת־ לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת־ נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ־ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·maṯ- lā·mōw kiḏ·mūṯ ḥă·maṯ- nā·ḥāš kə·mōw- p̄e·ṯen ḥê·rêš ya’·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw
verses.literal: Their venom is like the venom of a snake like a cobra that shuts . . . its ears

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·wl mə·la·ḥă·šîm ḥō·w·ḇêr ḥă·ḇā·rîm mə·ḥuk·kām
verses.literal: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell . . .

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס־ שִׁנֵּ֥ימוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm hă·rās- šin·nê·mōw bə·p̄î·mōw mal·tə·‘ō·wṯ kə·p̄î·rîm nə·ṯōṣ Yah·weh
verses.literal: O God shatter their teeth in their mouths O LORD tear out the fangs of the lions

verses.original: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ־ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־ לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חִצּוֹ כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yim·mā·’ă·sū ḵə·mōw- ma·yim yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū- lā·mōw yiḏ·rōḵ ḥiṣ·ṣō kə·mōw yiṯ·mō·lā·lū
verses.literal: May they vanish like water that runs off when they draw the bow may their arrows be blunted

verses.original: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל־ חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw šab·bə·lûl te·mes ya·hă·lōḵ nê·p̄el ’ê·šeṯ bal- ḥā·zū šā·meš
verses.literal: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime like a woman’s stillborn child may they never see the sun

verses.original: בְּטֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ־ חַ֥י כְּמוֹ־ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem yā·ḇî·nū sî·rō·ṯê·ḵem ’ā·ṭāḏ kə·mōw- ḥay kə·mōw- ḥā·rō·wn yiś·‘ā·ren·nū
verses.literal: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns whether green or . . . dry He will sweep them away

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי־ חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·maḥ ṣad·dîq kî- ḥā·zāh nā·qām pə·‘ā·māw yir·ḥaṣ bə·ḏam hā·rā·šā‘
verses.literal: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked

verses.original: וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ־ פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·mar ’ā·ḏām ’aḵ- pə·rî laṣ·ṣad·dîq ’aḵ yêš- ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·p̄ə·ṭîm bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then men will say There is surely a reward for the righteous There is surely a God who judges the earth
